name: LongMemEval-S standard-tier questions in Chinese
description: Each standard-tier LongMemEval-S question, translated once into Chinese and pinned, so the harness can search the English sessions with a Chinese question. Only the search query is translated.

rules: Translate the question faithfully; do not answer, add, or drop anything, including an abstention question's false premise.
Keep names, titles, and brands as a Chinese speaker writes them: a common Chinese name where one exists (星巴克, 宜家, 谷歌), otherwise as written.

questions.question: Which streaming service did I start using most recently?
questions.zh: 我最近开始用的是哪个流媒体服务？

questions.question: What was the date on which I attended the first BBQ event in June?
questions.zh: 我参加六月第一场烧烤活动是哪一天？

questions.question: Which item did I purchase first, the dog bed for Max or the training pads for Luna?
questions.zh: 给 Max 买的狗窝和给 Luna 买的训练尿垫，我先买的是哪个？

questions.question: Which health issue did I deal with first, the persistent cough or the skin tag removal?
questions.zh: 持续咳嗽和切除皮赘，我先处理的是哪个健康问题？

questions.question: What is the order of the three trips I took in the past three months, from earliest to latest?
questions.zh: 过去三个月我去的三次旅行，按从早到晚的顺序是怎样的？

questions.question: Which group did I join first, 'Page Turners' or 'Marketing Professionals'?
questions.zh: 「Page Turners」和「Marketing Professionals」这两个小组，我先加入的是哪个？

questions.question: How many days ago did I participate in the 5K charity run?
questions.zh: 我是几天前参加 5 公里慈善跑的？

questions.question: Which event happened first, the road trip to the coast or the arrival of the new prime lens?
questions.zh: 开车去海边旅行和新定焦镜头到货，哪件事先发生？

questions.question: How long did I use my new binoculars before I saw the American goldfinches returning to the area?
questions.zh: 我用新双筒望远镜多久之后，看到美洲金翅雀回到了这一带？

questions.question: Which trip did the narrator take first, the solo trip to Europe or the family road trip across the American Southwest?
questions.zh: 讲述者先去的是哪次旅行，独自去欧洲，还是全家自驾穿越美国西南部？

questions.question: Which device did I set up first, the smart thermostat or the new router?
questions.zh: 智能温控器和新路由器，我先装好的是哪个？

questions.question: Which bike did I fixed or serviced the past weekend?
questions.zh: 上周末我修理或保养的是哪辆自行车？

questions.question: How many days passed between the day I started playing along to my favorite songs on my old keyboard and the day I discovered a bluegrass band?
questions.zh: 从我开始用旧电子琴跟着喜欢的歌弹奏，到发现一支蓝草乐队，中间隔了几天？

questions.question: What is the artist that I started to listen to last Friday?
questions.zh: 我上周五开始听的是哪位艺人？

questions.question: Who became a parent first, Rachel or Alex?
questions.zh: Rachel 和 Alex 谁先当上了父母？
